overview: چارلی از زندان آزاد می‌شود و فوراً توسط یک پادری تقلبی دزدیده می‌شود. یک هم‌دست سابق زندانی، چارلی را متقاعد می‌کند تا در سرقت خانه‌ای شرکت کند.
overview_en: Charlie Chaplin's 49th Film Released May 27 1916 Police was Charlie Chaplin's 14th released film from Essanay. It was made at the Majestic Studio in Los Angeles. Charlie playing an ex-convict finds life on the outside not to his liking and leads him to breaking into a home with another thief (Wesley Ruggles).
